name: {{ cookiecutter.project_name }}
description: A short description of the project.
contact_name: A point of contact is needed for the project. What is the name of the point of contact?

__prompts__.name: What is the name of the project or software
__prompts__.description: Provide a short description of the software. It should be a single line containing a single sentence. Maximum 150 characters are allowed.
__prompts__.status: What is the status of the project?
__prompts__.license: What license is the project under?
__prompts__.license_URL: What is the URL for the liscence of this project
__prompts__.organization: What is the organization or component within the agency to which the releases listed belong. For example, '18F' or 'Navy'.
__prompts__.version: What is the version for this release. For example, '1.0.0'.
__prompts__.usage_type: What is the permissioned usage for this release? For more information on each option, visit github.com/DSACMS/gov-codejson
__prompts__.homepageURL: What is the URL of the public release homepage?
__prompts__.downloadURL: What is the URL where a distribution of the release can be found?
__prompts__.disclaimerURL: What is the URL where disclaimer language regarding the release can be found.
__prompts__.disclaimerText: A short paragraph that includes disclaimer language to accompany the release.
__prompts__.repository_visibility: Is this project public or private
__prompts__.vcs: What version control system is used?
__prompts__.laborHours: How many labor hours are invested in the project? Calculated using COCOMO measured by the SCC tool: https://github.com/boyter/scc?tab=readme-ov-file#cocomo
__prompts__.languages: What programming language(s) is the software written in? Separate items by commas.
__prompts__.contract_number: What is the contractor number of the project?
__prompts__.tags: Provide a list of tags to describe the software for search. Separate items by commas.
__prompts__.feedback_mechanisms: What are methods a repository receives feedback from the community (e.g. URL to GitHub repository issues page, website, email)
__prompts__.SBOM: Link of the upstream repositories and dependencies used, in the form of a Software Bill of Materials/SBOM. If the software does not have a SBOM, enter 'None'. (i.e. Github provides an SBOM: https://github.com/$ORG_NAME/$REPO_NAME/network/dependencies)
__prompts__.AIUseCaseID: The software's ID in the AI Use Case Inventory. If the software is not currently listed in the inventory, enter '0'.
